mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant renal impairment and electrolyte wasting, potentially affecting medroxyprogesterone metabolism and efficacy; medroxyprogesterone may have immunosuppressive effects that could complicate fungal infection management.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely during concurrent use; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate contraceptive backup if medroxyprogesterone efficacy is compromised.
